source: IMF World Economic Outlook (DataMapper API, Oct 2026 edition) for GDP/growth/debt; World Bank WDI SP.POP.TOTL (2024) for population, IMF WEO LP as fallback (Taiwan); SIPRI Military Expenditure Database (2024 data, as reproduced in World Bank WDI MS.MIL.XPND.CD and the SIPRI fact sheet of Apr 2025) for defence spending; IISS Military Balance 2024-2026 via Wikipedia for personnel; FAS Status of World Nuclear Forces 2026 for warheads; bloc membership from official bloc websites.
